SELECT fp.SECID finprodMarketId, fp.SECNAME finprodAbbr, fp.SECNAME finprodName, fp.MARKET tradeMarket, sdl3.item_value tradeMarketStr, fp.ISSUERSHORT issueRshortStr, fp.ISSUEAMT issueAmt, fp.PROTECT_OBJECT protectObject, sdl4.item_value protectObjectStr, null refSecFeatures, fp.PROTECTED_BOND refSec, fp.REF_ENTITY refEntity, fp.MDATE mDate, fp.VDATE vDate, null gracePeriod, fp.BOOK_BUILDING_DATE pledgeDeadlineDate, fp.PAY_DATE payDate, fp.CIRCULATION_DATE listingDate, null calendarId, fp.ISSUEPRICE issuePrice, fp.RATEBASIC ratebasic, fp.SETTLE_METHOD settleMethod, sdl2.item_value settleMethodStr, fp2.IS_ALLOW_OVERWRITE isAllowOverwrite, sdl1.item_value isOrNoStr, null remark FROM INTERF_CREDITINFO fp left join FIN_PRODUCT fp2 on fp.SECID = fp2.FINPROD_MARKET_ID LEFT JOIN SYS_DATADICT_LIST sdl1 on sdl1.dict_code ='YES_OR_NO' and sdl1.item_code = fp2.IS_ALLOW_OVERWRITE LEFT JOIN SYS_DATADICT_LIST sdl2 on sdl2.dict_code ='SETTLE_METHOD' and sdl2.item_code = fp.SETTLE_METHOD LEFT JOIN SYS_DATADICT_LIST sdl3 on sdl3.dict_code ='TRADE_PLACE' and sdl3.item_code = fp.MARKET LEFT JOIN SYS_DATADICT_LIST sdl4 on sdl4.dict_code ='PROTECT_OBJECT' and sdl4.item_code = fp.PROTECT_OBJECT
AND fp.SECID = #{finprodMarketId}
